MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

2. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

3. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.

7. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

10. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.

   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

14. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
